In Paris the smog in the air was soon thicker than it was in Beijing, China the citied known for its polluted air . Soon, Parisian officials enforced a partial driving ban to clear the air of smog . On Monday, motorists with even-numbered plates had been ordered to leave their cars at home or get a 22-euro fine, which is also $31 . The same requirements were set for odd-numbered plates the following day . The first time this new ban was enforced, nearly 4,000 dirvers were fined . Some even had their cars impounded for their reaction to the new fine . The amount of traffic was down 60 percent in the capital of France after the five days of an intensifying smog . The smog was caused by cold nights and warm days that caused the warmer layer of air to trap the car emissions . Diesel fuel was of course blamed as France has a tax policy for diesel fuel over gassoline . 67 percent of vehicles in Frane compared to the average of 53.3 percent of diesel engines in the rest of Western Europe . Paris would typically have more smog than the other European countries with the percentage of diesel they use daily . Last week, Paris had 147 micrograms of diesel per cubic meter compared to 114 in Brussels and 79.7 in London . Delivery companies lost revenue, but this is an exception for plug-in cars, hybrids and cars carrying three or more passengers . Soon the smog had cleared on Monday for the ruling French party to take away the ban on odd-number plates on Tuesday . The United States has long been one of the world's prime car cultures . President Obama's ambitious goals to curb greenhouse gas emissions in the United States, unveiled last week, will get a fortuitous assist from an incipient shift in American behavior .

Emotions are the basis of human nature , emotions make humans humans . Why should a computer be able to dictate the emotions of students in a classroom ? There are more forms of emotions than the six that Dr. Eckman classified. There is more than being able to "modifly a lesson, like an effective human instructor." This technology shows no value to the everyday classroom or everyday life . It does not help with the problems in the classroom and there is no need for an emotion reader when there are 30+ emotion readers in that room, the students and teachers . To start, the article states that: "In fact, we humans perform this same impressive “calculation” every day. For example, you can probably tell by the look on her face how a friend is feeling." Humans have the capacity to know the emotions of someone else by looking at them and even talking to them . These computers can not communicate effectively with empathy the way people can. A computer is programmed to a degree of settings rather than a human brain that has access to every possible feeling and emotion there is . To continue, there are on average about 25 students in a classroom with the ratio of 1 teacher . Dr. Huang states that: "A classroom computer could recognize when a student is confused or bored, then it could modify the lesson, like an effective human instructor." Many flaws can occur when this technology scans multiple students at the same time. To modify the lesson for every emotion in that classrom would make the lesson more confusing for the students and it would send the technology into a breakdown not having the capacity to handle all these newfound emotions . An "effective human instructor" would be able to provide a simplified lesson to those who struggle while still maintaining the focus of the other students in the class . It has been proven that students memorize and learn better with paper than computers . Maybe that should be a sign that these technological advances should stay away from the classroom . In conclusion, Dr. Huang himself stated that: "Most human communication is nonverbal, including emotional communication, so computers need to understand that too." The technology has flaws, the developers knowing that it would not understand many things . Why bring flawed software into classrooms that hold the future of the society? Science cannot continue to use these students with uncanny importance to the world as test subjects . Keep the software out, let learning and growing in. "Can we actually “calculate” emotions—like math homework?" Yes, it is possible, but it should not be the route in which we help education thrive.

On the other hand, going without a car certainly has more pros than cons . There's less stress, it's cheaper, there's less traffic, it's healthier and there's less pollution. For example, in Paris there was so much smog that they had to ban cars. If people violated the ban they had to pay a fine or even get their car impounded . They blamed diesel fuel for the smog because in France that's nearly 67 percent of the fuel of cars . The smog of the cities rivaled Bejings, and that's the most polluted city in the world! Going without a car is also less stressful. People don't have to worry about how they'll make the next car payment or how they might run out of gas . There's also virtually no chance of getting in an accident . After all, how is someone going to get in an accident without a car? Not only is going without a car the better economical choice , its the best personal choice . Why would someone deliberately put themsleeves through the stress of owning a car when they can easily go without it? Though it has some benefits, like being independent, those benefits are greatly outnumbered by the pros of going without . It's just cheaper and less stressful. Who wouldn't want that?

Around the world, the idea of a car-free life has become more appealing. In the United States, South America and across Europe, they have developed new modes of transportation that seem to be more beneficial. In these souces they explain the many advantages of limiting car use such as its better for the environment and people find more alternative ways of transportation easier and cheaper . Limiting car use has many benefits and the first is that it improves the environment . In Source 1 it says that reducing car usage would be "a huge impediment to current efforts to drastically reduce greenhouse gas emissions from tailpipes". Passengers in Europe are responsible for 12 percent of greenhouse gas emissions and 50 percent in the United States . "All of our development since World War II has been centered on the car and that will have to change," said David Goldberg, an official of Transportation for America . In this recent change, there have been many efforts to promote "car reduced" communities . In Source 2 Paris shows that they have made improvements in the ban on driving on certain days of the week due to smog . That smog cleared enough for the people to drive on days they were allowed to. The second benefit of limiting car use would be that people would find more alternative ways of transportation easier and they would be happier . "When i had a car i was always tense. Im much happier this way," said Heidrun Walter, a media trainer and mother of two, as she walked verdant streets where the swish of bicycles and the chatter of wandering children drown out the occasional distant motor . Many people expressed that other modes of transportation like biking or walking are much easier . In Source 3 it explains that Colombia has car-free days where they skate, bike, hike or take buses instead. "Its a good opportunity to take away stress and lower air pollution," said businessman Carlos Arturo Plaza as he rode a two-seat bicycle with his wife. In Source 4, it says that because other modes of transportation are easier and cheaper, "Recent studies suggest that Americans buy fewer cars, drive less and get fewer licenses each year." Imagine life with little to no cars, think of all the sites that you will see because now you walk everywhere you go . You will notice and apprehend things you haven't before, this idea is all thanks to a suburban town in VAUBAN, Germany . Now we will be able to enjoy the sites of our surroundings and the people in it, produce less gas emissions and a better outlook on the future . "When I had a car, I was always tense. I'm much happier this way" said Heidrun Walter, a resident of VAUBAN, Germany . Getting rid of our cars may sound like a scary thought, but in reality it can bring great things to us . When we stop bundling ourselves in our automoblies we get to explore the world better, we get to touch and smell the things around us and appreaciate them. We advance our knowledge of the things and people around us by walking to our daily commute or day off . We also meet new people, around every corner will be a new face, maybe they or you will ask for help and spark a friendship from there . You'll find a sea of people who have the same interest as you or don't, but because we no longer rely on cars we are introduced to the world more and are truly exposed to the people and things in it, giving us a better understanding of where we live and all that it has to give to us . Global warming, we hear about it a lot especially today where green house emissions are high , but when we reduce the use of cars the world benefits along with us . In Paris, after days of near-record pollution, a partial driving ban was imposed in order to "clear the air of the global city." "Four thousand drivers were fined and twenty-seven people had their cars impounded for the reaction to the fine . By Monday the smog had cleared enough and the French party rescinded the band for odd numbered plates on Tuesday . Meanwhile, in BOTOGA, Colombia, it has been the third consecutive year that cars have been banned in the hope of promoting alternative transportation and smog . This event has been so successful that "for the first time two other Colombian cities, Cali and Valledupar, joined the event." We all dream of living a long, happy life, but in order to do so we need to treat our earth right. When we reduce our use of cars, we can fulfill this dream. "Parks and sport centers also have bloomed through the city; uneven, pitted sidewalks have been replaced by broad, smooth sidewalks; rush-hour restrictions have dramatically cut traffic; and new restaurants and upscale shopping districts have emerged." Imagine living in a new nice community, better economy and better health. With all the walking and biking everywhere we are faced with physical workouts, benefiting considering that America is considered the most obese nation . And with all the walking and biking, stores are made closer to walking distance instead of on a distant highway, bring in more consumers. Without cars there are also less deaths due to them . In result, we have a better look into the future than we might have if we didn't decide to get rid of cars . In conclusion, getting rid of cars would benefit the world and the people in it entirely. We would be more aware of our surroundings and citizens, reduce global warming and have a better future to look upon.

Many students get confused and bored during class . It may be the lesson, but it could also be the teacher and how the teacher is explaining the lesson . With the facial action code system, computers will be able to detect when a student is slowly confused or bored . The software is the latest innovation of Prof. Thomas Huang of the Beckman Institute for Advanced Science at the University of Illinoise, working in collaboration with Prof. Nicu Sebe of the University of Amsterdam . Dr. Huang and his colleague are experts in developing better ways for humans and computers to communicate . "A classroom computer could recognize when a student is confused or bored," predicts Dr. Huang . There are a million reasons to use the facial action code system and class is one of them . In class, there are many different types of students . Some students may understand a lesson very easily and quickly . Although there are plenty of other types of students . One type of student that exists is the student who might have trouble comprehending a lesson . There are also students who have trouble paying attention to the teacher or lesson . Another type of student is the one who gets bored easily. When a student is bored, it may be difficult for him or her to fully comprehend the lesson that is being taught at the moment . The program "Facial Action Coding System" enables computers to identify human emotions . The process begins when the computer constructs a 3-D computer model of the face . This software then allows the teachers to know when the student does not understand or on what part of the lesson is confused the student . This program can help by letting the teacher know when the student is struggling to understand what is being taught so that the teacher can make a few adjustments to the lesson . In school, there are students who can easily get bored. The program, the "Facial Action Coding System", can also detect when a student is bored. Students who are bored may have a harder time listening or understanding the lesson . If there is a part of the lesson where the student is beginning to feel bored, the computer will be able to tell. Now that the teacher knows that the student (or students) are bored, he or she can go back to the lesson and try to make it more enjoyable . Even with all these benefits, there are also some flaws to the idea of having this program on the computers . Having a facial action code system can be expensive to have. There are a lot of computers in a few schools . Having many computers can lead to having to spend a lot of money to have this program in the computer . Some schools will not be able to afford the facial action code system . Another flaw in this idea is how students act. Some students will be able to take this program seriously, other students may be childish about it . The students who are childish about it can end up making fake facial reactions . The students will make bored or confused facial expressions to give the teacher a hard time with the lesson . There are also the students who are always bored. No matter what the teacher does to improve the lesson, the student will always be bored . Although that is not always the case with students . Another problem that students may come across is the teacher. The teacher may not want to change or improve the lesson for the students because he or she believes that it should stay like that. Through all these negatives, there are still positives to this program. The Facial Action Coding System program can help students who are struggling. Not every student is the same and not every student may need the same help as other students do . Facial Action Coding System can be very helpful if people use it correctly .

Many driverless cars offer safety features such as GM creating driver seats that vibrate when the vehicle is in danger of backing into or object . The concept of the driverless car is not yet completely driverless because all these types of cars force their driver to stay alert at any scene by notifying them when the road ahead requires human driving skills . Developers are also considering using cameras in driverless cars to watch drivers to make sure they are focused on the road . The idea of a driverless may seem scary and dangerous, but manufacturers are making sure to put as many safety features as possible to keep the roads safe for everyone . Driverless cars are a cool concept that everyone will want to know about . These cars have many sensors that allow them to remain driverless on the road . While still acknowledging safety, driverless cars give drivers security on the road by allowing drivers to remain focused but more relaxed . That is why researchers should continue to explore the idea of driverless cars and how they would positively impact the world .

Could Earth end up turning out like Venus? NASA has sent many spacecraft to Venus to find out what it is like under the atmosphere . Although it may seem like a waste of time to send stuff there, studying Venus is a worthy persuit despite the dangers because it can teach us more about our solar system, it can possibly be a replacement planet and if we find out that it was like Earth we could try and fix it before it happens again . Studying the planet Venus would help us better understand the rest of our solar system . The taxt says "A thick atmosphere of almost 97% carbon dioxide blankets Venus (paragraph 3)" It also states that the pressure is 90 times greater than what we experience on our own planet (paragraph 3) . We haven't seen anything like this, which is why we need to study it. Venus could possibly be a replacement planet for Earth. We just need to find out how we could make it a liveable planet in case the Earth keeps getting worse and worse . It states: "Often referred to as Eath's "twin," Venus is the closest planet to Earth in terms of density and size (paragraph 2)" The text also states that "Venus was probably covered largely with oceans and could have supported various forms of life, just like Earth (paragraph 4)." These mean that at one point we could have lived on Venus since it was so much like Earth . If we were to keep studying Venus and find out lots about it then we could see if Earth would eventually turn out like that . As stated "Long ago, Venus was probably covered largely with oceans and could have supported various forms of life, just like Earth (paragraph 4)." Another point is that "Venus still has some features that are analogous to those on Earth...such as valleys, mountains and craters (paragraph 4)." This says that Earth and Venus look a lot alike and they could be "twin" planets , which also means that the Earth could end up being just like Venus one day . We need to study more about Venus to help ourselves and the Earth so that we don't end up like Venus . They either need to send ships to research Venus to help Earth or have to find another planet for our future generations to live on.
